contract.inheritance: Inherited by every fact in the owning context.
contract.meaning: The fact is part of the exact maintained Riverhog-repository v1 external contract.
contract.scope: All external-contract audit contexts unless a narrower policy is also listed.

contract.inheritance: Inherited by every fact in an extent context in addition to external-contract-fact/v1.
contract.meaning: The fact declares an intentional extent classification and its executable authority.

exclusion.inheritance: Never inherited; each excluded launcher candidate names it explicitly.
exclusion.meaning: The installed entry point only starts a separately inventoried process protocol and has no independent CLI contract.
exclusion.scope: Installed service, adapter, observer, target, sampler, and effect launchers.
